rice.label: D
rice.source: D: the start rule from the model's own flows (the PM's ruling on M038b, math-reports 620e8168): the crop's monthly use, crop 6798600 t (crop_farming_jpn.json: 令和6年産 主食用, MAFF published 2024-12-10) x (1 - reserve_share 0.03, T: crop_farming_jpn.json, set in 1d15aa4f) / 12 = 549554 t, less food manufacturing's bid at capacity 2424.9 bn (311192 t); tools/modern/start_flows.py. It replaces the old crop's split (0.48528) carried onto the new crop

vegetables.label: D
vegetables.source: D: the start rule from the model's own flows (the PM, TO_E 21:11 item 2): (the crop 10999400 t (crop_farming_jpn.json: 令和5年産 出荷量, MAFF published 2024-12-23) x (1 - reserve_share 0.00, T) + the year's imports 2777000 t (trading_house_jpn.json's imports_t_yr: MAFF 食料需給表 令和5年度 野菜 輸入量, published 2024-08-08; R96i)) / 12, less food manufacturing's bid at capacity (307095 t); tools/modern/start_flows.py. It replaces (11.0 + 2.7 Mt) / 12 less a bid at the pre-purge coefficient (R96i: imports 2.777 Mt)

wheat.label: D
wheat.source: D: the start rule from the model's own flows (the PM, TO_E 21:11 item 2): (the crop 1023672 t (crop_farming_jpn.json: 令和6年産, MAFF published 2024-11-26) x (1 - reserve_share 0.02, T) + the state's imports 5000000 t/yr (trading_house_jpn.json's wheat in transit x 12: MAFF 食料需給表 令和5年度, published 2024-08-08)) / 12, less food manufacturing's bid at capacity (404342 t); tools/modern/start_flows.py. The 1.006 Mt it replaces matched no release (R96e: NF)

soybeans.label: D
soybeans.source: D: the start rule from the model's own flows (the PM, TO_E 21:11 item 2): (the crop 261443 t (crop_farming_jpn.json: 令和5年産, MAFF published 2024-04-10) x (1 - reserve_share 0.02, T) + the year's imports 3155521 t (trading_house_jpn.json's imports_t_yr: 財務省 貿易統計 2023 確定, published 2024-11-13)) / 12, less food manufacturing's bid at capacity (247188 t); tools/modern/start_flows.py.
